capabilityCards.saythanks:
## saythanks
SayThanks is the MakerKit/Supabase application and product workspace for gratitude, public giving, nonprofit discovery, team spaces, donations, admin review, billing, public pages, and production safety work. The main `saythanks.big.rvf` store is the broad source/documentation/code store. Use it first for product-level or repo-level SayThanks questions, then route map-specific architecture questions to the four companion stores below. Reach for saythanks whenever a question names SayThanks, public discovery, nonprofit claim/review, giving destination, donation/tip flows, MakerKit/Supabase app boundaries, or SayThanks operational docs.
capabilityCards.saythanks-ua-large:
## saythanks-ua-large
SayThanks Understand-Anything large map companion. This RVF projects the active/current SUPERB UA repo-map corpus into searchable passages with node summaries, edge relations, source paths, source commits, artifact hashes, and UA graph provenance. Use it for exact file/function/module explanations and for prompts that should send a subagent to `understand-explain <file-or-symbol>`. Prefer it when the question asks what a specific component does, which layer a file belongs to, or which UA node/edge records back a proposed migration. Reach for saythanks-ua-large when a SayThanks question mentions Understand-Anything, UA, knowledge graph, node summaries, edge relations, file/function explanation, or understand-explain prompts.
capabilityCards.saythanks-graphify:
## saythanks-graphify
SayThanks Graphify map companion. This RVF contains Graphify communities, focus slices, important nodes, extracted AST edges, confidence labels, line locations, and source file neighborhoods. Use it for structural blast radius, community discovery, surprising relationships, god-node style anchors, and cross-file dependency slices. Prefer it when a subagent needs to identify which implementation files travel together before changing code. Reach for saythanks-graphify when a SayThanks question mentions Graphify, communities, focus slices, blast radius, god nodes, source neighborhoods, call/import relationships, or migration impact.
capabilityCards.saythanks-repowise:
## saythanks-repowise
SayThanks RepoWise map companion. This RVF exports RepoWise wiki/audit material from the SayThanks sidecar, including subsystem explanations, onboarding context, health/audit findings, wiki pages, and source-backed prose. Use it for human-readable subsystem context before exact symbol work, and for subagent prompts that need a concise explanation of what an area is for. Reach for saythanks-repowise when a SayThanks question mentions RepoWise, wiki DB, subsystem overview, onboarding, health findings, audit pages, or readable architecture prose.
capabilityCards.saythanks-ix-large:
## saythanks-ix-large
SayThanks IX / ix-map RVF signpost. This store is useful for discovering that IX has relevant source-group, symbol graph, source URI, digest, path/name, and Arango-backed relationship evidence, but it is not the authority for final exact symbol, call graph, reference, import, or line-range answers. When IX evidence is needed, route the specialist to native IX from the registered SayThanks workspace and direct Arango scoped by workspace_id. Reach for saythanks-ix-large when a SayThanks question mentions IX, ix-map, Arango, symbol graph, source URI, relationship edge, cross-reference, exact symbol, call graph, imports, references, line ranges, source groups, current graph, source digests, schema/migration maps, or live graph status.
capabilityCards.saythanks-ix-direct:
## saythanks-ix-direct
Direct native IX recipe for SayThanks. Use this when RB decides the question needs exact symbols, calls, references, imports, line ranges, path/name graph evidence, source URI records, or Arango-backed neighborhoods. Work on host daxiom-superb from /opt/quantic-impact/clients/daxiom/sidecars/repo-workspaces/saythanks. For exact function lookup run: ix search "<symbol>" --kind function --format json --limit 10. Add --path "<relative-path>" when the question is scoped to one file or folder. For graph traversal, query ArangoDB database ix_memory with AQL scoped by workspace_id; never answer from an unscoped graph traversal. A good smoke result for ix search "buildHtml" --kind function returns the two SayThanks functions in billing-dunning-email.service.ts and owner-pending-thanks-email.service.ts. Treat saythanks-ix-large as routing/source-context, not final structural authority.
capabilityCards.saythanks-graphify-direct:
## saythanks-graphify-direct
Direct Graphify recipe for SayThanks. Use this when RB decides the question needs communities, clusters, dependency neighborhoods, surprising relationships, blast radius, god-node anchors, focus slices, or connected implementation areas. Query the SayThanks Graphify sidecar for the feature or source path, then return the community or focus-slice id, important nodes, confidence labels, line locations when present, source files, and edge types. A good answer names the Graphify community or focus slice first, then gives the files a code agent should inspect. Corroborate exact symbols or line ranges with IX or source after Graphify identifies the area.
capabilityCards.saythanks-ua-direct:
## saythanks-ua-direct
Direct Understand-Anything recipe for SayThanks. Use this when RB decides the question needs semantic node/edge architecture explanation, layer classification, conceptual dependency, or a prompt for understand-explain. Run the Understand-Anything skill or CLI against a specific file, symbol, or narrowed feature prompt; ask for architecture layer, incoming and outgoing edges, connected nodes, source path, and confidence/provenance. A good answer explains what the code means in the architecture and names the UA node records backing that explanation. Corroborate stale or trash-heavy UA evidence against current source before treating it as current.
capabilityCards.saythanks-repowise-direct:
## saythanks-repowise-direct
Direct RepoWise recipe for SayThanks. Use this when RB decides the question needs readable subsystem overview, docs/wiki context, ADR or plan understanding, workflow guidance, audit findings, onboarding, operations packets, or human prose before exact code work. Query the SayThanks RepoWise wiki/audit sidecar for the subsystem or document, return the relevant page ids/titles, summary, caveats, and source paths to verify. A good answer uses RepoWise to frame the work, then hands exact symbol or graph questions to IX, Graphify, UA, or current source.
